product_metadata.title: Fox Run Stick-Um Candle Adhesive, 0.5-Ounce
features: MAKE YOUR CANDLES STICK: Tired of placing new candles into their holders, only to have them fall out or tip over? Thanks to this Stick-Um Candle Adhesive, worry no more! Just a little bit will have your candles sticking up right in no time.
BETTER THAN WAX: Unlike melted wax, this adhesive keeps your candles firm without hardening or leaving a mess behind.
CONVENIENT STORAGE: This adhesive is readily available and stored in a small, pocket-sized round tin. Easy to keep in a cabinet or drawer until you need it!
EASY TO USE: Simply place a small portion of the adhesive to the bottom of the candle, and then press and twist into place! Ideal for wobbly candles.
MEASUREMENTS: This adhesive weighs 1.44 ounces and has dimensions of 2 x 2 x 0.5 inches.
